name: Mischievous Intent
description: Combining a smirk with the devil face to show playfully mischievous or flirty intentions.
meaning: Used to express mischievous, flirty, or suggestive intent. Implies something sneaky or naughty is being planned.
examples: What are you up to tonight 😏😈
seoDescription: What does 😏😈 mean? The smirk and devil emoji combo explained. Used for mischievous or flirty intentions.
